answer.rationale: HazCom training is triggered only when a new chemical hazard not previously trained on is introduced. The scenario does not establish whether the cleaning product is hazardous or presents a hazard employees have not already been trained on, which is the material fact needed to determine whether §1910.1200(h)(1) training obligation is triggered.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Need to know whether the new cleaning product is a hazardous chemical (per its SDS) and whether it introduces a hazard class or hazard information employees have not previously received training on.
